answer: How do you stop 1,000 fake identities at once? Time-locked staking freezes the attacker's capital. Each identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs, unlocking 5% per honest epoch. A fake forfeits 60% and resets the timer. Waiting ties up 150,000 units. A bridge of borrowed funds pays the same lock. No oasis of cheap identities. What does a sybil farm cost? 150,000 units locked, 27,000 slashed, zero turnover for 20 epochs. Capital cannot wander.
